svg.text: STAGE 454 · TOPIC 94 · SVG 98 · 🎉 HISTORIC 911-GUARDRAIL, 920-PROBE & 730-LIVE-POC MILESTONE (P901–P902)
Enterprise WebRTC RFC 3550 SSRC Collision & RFC 8108 CSRC Mixer Loop Guard
Eliminating 50Hz RTCP BYE SSRC Re-Allocation Storms, Cascaded Bridge Howling & CC=15 Header Overreads
🎉 911 GUARDS · 920 PROBES · 730 POC
457 Dims · 96 FAQs · 896 Tests
❌ Unguarded RFC 3550/8108: RTCP BYE Storm & Mixer Howling
1. RFC 3550 Unconditional RTCP BYE SSRC Re-Allocation Storm
• Looped media path or spoofed packet echoes local SSRC back in 20ms.
• Legacy RFC 3550 sends RTCP BYE, resets SRTP ROC & jitter buffer, and
picks a new random SSRC that breaks browser SDP a=ssrc bindings!
• Triggers 50Hz RTCP BYE self-destruct storm & permanent dead air!
Result: 50Hz Stream-Reset Storm & Trivial Spoofed-SSRC Call Drop
2. RFC 8108 Cascaded Mixer CSRC Positive-Feedback Howling Loop
• WebRTC Mixer M1 cascades with SIP Bridge M2 (40ms round-trip loop).
• M1 only subtracts M2's top-level SSRC and ignores CSRC=[1001, 2002].
• Talker 1001's audio circulates between M1↔M2, saturating to 0 dBFS
howling in 600ms! Plus truncated CC=15 header overreads 60B of heap!
Result: Deafening Cross-Bridge Acoustic Howling & CSRC Heap Overread
✅ RFC 3550 Pinning Guard (P901) & RFC 8108 CSRC Guard (P902 🎉)
P901 · RFC 3550 SSRC Transport Pinning & [1000, 10000]ms Cooldown
• Pins each negotiated a=ssrc to its authenticated DTLS-SRTP context.
• Silently drops cross-transport spoofed or looped SSRC packets in 0ms.
• Clamps legitimate SSRC collision re-allocation cooldown to [1,000,
10,000]ms (2,000ms nominal) — 0 RTCP BYE reset storms!
clampedSsrcCollisionByeStormOrHijackPackets = 0 · Cooldown ∈ [1000, 10000]ms
P902 (🎉 911th Guard!) · RFC 8108 CSRC Union Loop & CC [0, 15] Guard
• Inspects full contributor union (SSRC ∪ CSRC[0..CC-1]) before mixing.
• Suppresses any cascaded frame whose CSRC intersects target branch.
• Validates packetBytes >= 12 + 4*CC and clamps CC to [0, 15].
• 100% eliminates cross-bridge howling & CSRC buffer overreads!
clampedCsrcFeedbackLoopOrOverreadPackets = 0 · CC Count ∈ [0, 15]
